name: Openverse SFX Asset Sourcing CLI
purpose: Queries Openverse REST API to retrieve free, Creative Commons CC0 / CC BY audio assets without API keys.
capabilities: Search Creative Commons audio by keyword (whoosh, click, impact)
Public CDN preview retrieval avoiding authenticated API restrictions

licensing.notes: Internal workspace tool sourcing CC0/CC BY assets.

security.notes: Outbound HTTP GET to public Openverse API; downloads saved to assets/audio/sfx/.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 4B audio pipeline.
